title.en: Distinguish password adding from password updating
title.zh: 明确区分添加密码与更新密码

purpose.en: Ensure a passwordless member can add a password without a current-password field, while a password-enabled member must confirm the current password before updating it.
purpose.zh: 确保无密码会员添加密码时不显示当前密码字段，而已有密码的会员必须验证当前密码后才能更新。

en: Detect Clerk password capability before rendering the signed-in Account security form.
Hide the current-password field completely for passwordless accounts and label the action Add password.
Require the current password for password-enabled accounts and keep the action labeled Update password.
zh: 在渲染已登录账户安全表单前检测 Clerk 账户是否已有密码。
无密码账户完全隐藏当前密码字段，并将操作明确标为“添加密码”。
已有密码账户必须输入当前密码，并将操作保持为“更新密码”。

en: SmartLingo twelve-language Account/Profile password settings and their shared password controls.
Clerk configuration, account identity, D1 member data, learning progress, colleges, payments, AI, and media remain unchanged.
zh: 涉及 SmartLingo 十二种语言的账户／个人资料密码设置及其共用密码控件。
Clerk 配置、账户身份、D1 会员数据、学习进度、学院、支付、AI 与媒体保持不变。

en: Use an executable add/update mode model derived from Clerk's passwordEnabled state.
Pass currentPassword to Clerk only in update mode; add mode submits only the new password from the authenticated session.
Localize Add password and its explanatory copy across all twelve interface languages while preserving the existing eye controls and breached-password protection.
zh: 使用由 Clerk passwordEnabled 状态驱动的可执行添加／更新模式模型。
仅在更新模式向 Clerk 传递 currentPassword；添加模式从已登录会话仅提交新密码。
为全部十二种界面语言本地化“添加密码”及说明文案，同时保留眼睛按钮和泄露密码保护。

en: Require executable add/update mode tests, the full repository suite, zero-warning ESLint, TypeScript no-emit, verified production build, sensitive-data scan, D1 replay, and the 260-case WebKit layout matrix.
Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then create an isolated random password account, update it to a second generated strong password, sign out, and sign in with the updated password.
zh: 要求可执行的添加／更新模式测试、全仓测试、零告警 ESLint、TypeScript no-emit、已验证生产构建、敏感数据扫描、D1 重放及 260 项 WebKit 布局矩阵通过。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare；随后创建隔离的随机密码账户，更新为第二个随机强密码，退出并使用更新后的密码重登。

en: SmartLingo continues to reject passwords found in known breach data; this security control is intentionally not relaxed.
No personal password or recovery code is used, logged, stored, or included in release evidence; the random QA account remains an ordinary unverified member.
zh: SmartLingo 继续拒绝已出现在已知泄露数据中的密码；该安全保护不会降低。
不使用、记录、保存或写入发布证据任何个人密码或找回验证码；随机 QA 账户始终只是未验证普通会员。

en: Reuse the existing eye treatment already established for protected SmartLingo course entry while adapting contrast for light account and auth surfaces.
Preserve the isolated SmartLingo repository, Clerk application, bindings, GitHub Actions-to-Cloudflare delivery, and user-owned untracked files.
zh: 复用 SmartLingo 受保护课程入口既有眼睛交互，并为浅色账户与登录界面调整对比度。
保留 SmartLingo 独立代码库、Clerk 应用、绑定、GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 流程及用户未跟踪文件。
